# exo_active_sync_organization_settings (Resource)

Manages the ActiveSyncOrganizationSettings configuration via Set-ActiveSyncOrganizationSettings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `admin_mail_recipients` (String) Maps to the -AdminMailRecipients parameter.
- `allow_access_for_un_supported_platform` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowAccessForUnSupportedPlatform parameter.
- `allow_rms_support_for_unenlightened_apps` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowRMSSupportForUnenlightenedApps parameter.
- `default_access_level` (String) Maps to the -DefaultAccessLevel parameter.
- `enable_mobile_mailbox_policy_when_ca_inplace` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableMobileMailboxPolicyWhenCAInplace parameter.
- `ota_notification_mail_insert` (String) Maps to the -OtaNotificationMailInsert parameter.
- `tenant_admin_preference` (String) Maps to the -TenantAdminPreference parameter.
- `user_mail_insert` (String) Maps to the -UserMailInsert parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
